components.label: Qualified measurement and clinical context review
checks: Accountable clinician reviews current symptoms, measurement validity, comorbidities and goals.
Medication reconciliation and any treatment decision need appropriate clinical authority.

components.label: Validated device, instruction and measurement support
checks: Confirm actual device and cuff suitability, standardized protocol and patient ability/agreement.
A generic virtual service or pharmacy tag does not establish device supply, training or usable readings.

components.label: Result review and coordinated follow-up
checks: Confirm named team, communication route, result review interval and symptom escalation process.
No automatic medication titration or patient contact is authorized by this proposal.

mappings.basis: Agere operational decomposition of measurement-review responsibilities informed by the AHA summary; not a clinical protocol, verified indication or declared buyer capability.
